title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Which Tier a Shipment May Take and on What Terms
content:
Each shipment carried by Aurelia Hanse Line has cargo protection under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`. This page states which protection the shipment starts with, what alternatives a cargo owner has, and the conditions a cover has to meet as to cargo, value, containers and the party holding it.

## Baseline protection

`AHL Standard Carrier Liability` stands on each shipment as its baseline. The system enters it on the records and attaches it when the line takes receipt of the cargo; its insured value is the invoice value held on file, and no premium is due for it.

## Alternatives open to a cargo owner

In place of the statutory tier, a cargo owner may choose `AHL Declared Value Liability`, which requires the cargo value to be declared on the transport document, or may choose any of the CargoCare products.

## Conditions on the cover

1. **Cargo category.** The cargo category shown on the cover must be one the tier accepts.
2. **Value band.** The insured value must be no lower than the tier's minimum insured value and no higher than its maximum cover value.
3. **Containers.** The number of containers on the cover must match the number of containers on the booking. Where the tier allows partial cover, the cover may take fewer containers than the booking carries.
4. **Forwarders and NVOCCs.** Holding by a freight forwarder or NVOCC on a cargo owner's behalf is open only under tiers that permit it. Whether the holder is such a party is read from the role registered on its customer record.

## Tier conditions

| Tier | Cargo categories accepted | Minimum insured value (USD) | Maximum cover value (USD) | Partial cover of a booking | Forwarder or NVOCC may hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 0.00 | 0.00 | no | yes |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 0.00 | 2000000.00 | no | no |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | general, out of gauge | 5000.00 | 500000.00 | no | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | general, reefer, out of gauge | 5000.00 | 1000000.00 | yes | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 10000.00 | 2500000.00 | yes | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 10000.00 | 5000000.00 | yes | no |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A booking of four containers of refrigerated cargo seeks `AHL CargoCare Essential`. Refrigerated cargo is not among the categories that tier accepts, so the cover does not meet the conditions.
- A cover under `AHL CargoCare Plus` would take two of a booking's three containers. Plus allows partial cover, so the lower container count is acceptable.
- The same two-of-three cover is sought under `AHL CargoCare Essential`. Essential does not allow partial cover, so the cover must take all three containers.
- A licensed NVOCC wishes to hold `AHL CargoCare Total` for a cargo owner's goods. Total does not permit holding on behalf, so the NVOCC cannot hold it.
- An insured value of 4800.00 sought under `AHL CargoCare Premium` falls below that tier's minimum of 10000.00 and is outside the value band.
